Hi Sandy —

Hope you’re well. Following up on our renewal cadence: we'd like to schedule Acme's QBR and an executive sponsor alignment session with our account team (VP/C-level + AE/SE). Proposed details:

- Date: Mon, Mar 22, 2026
- Time: 10:00 AM PT (60–90 min total; demo + exec alignment)
- Attendees: Tom Reynolds (VP Eng), Sandy Park (Customer Sponsor), Marissa Cole (CS lead), Neha Kapoor (AE), Dylan Brooks (SE)

Attached is an updated QBR agenda for your review (QBR-agenda-v2.pdf). If that slot doesn't work, please suggest 1–2 alternatives the execs prefer. Also let us know if procurement/security should be included.

High level goals:
- Exec alignment on success metrics and deployment/resourcing
- Technical demo of the new batching/quantization features relevant to your throughput
- Identify any procurement or compliance blockers ahead of the renewal

If you’d like, Marissa (cc) can handle calendar coordination across teams.

Thanks,
